title: Data Engineer
description: Designed and implemented a scalable data lakehouse architecture, ingesting over 2 TB of structured and semi-structured clinical, claims, provider, and operational data across 180+ hospitals. Built modular data pipelines using Airflow and dbt, orchestrating hourly incremental loads from 15+ upstream systems (~25M rows/day). Optimized ETL performance by 32% using Apache Spark on AWS EMR. Developed interactive Power BI dashboards reducing reporting SLAs from 48 hours to under 3 hours. Strengthened data governance with PHI masking/anonymization policies. Collaborated with Clinical Analytics and Actuarial teams enabling $3.4M/year in operational savings.

title: Data Engineer
